RESOURCE_KINDS.doc: Every resource a host plans a plugin for (FreeMixer/plugin-qualify#116): each measured per machine class, judged per host profile, and unknown, never a pass, when it has no figure.

cpu.doc: The cost per sample at a rate and quantum, its percentile and its tail (plugin-qualify#115).

text.en: The cost per sample at a rate and quantum, its percentile and its tail.

memory.doc: The footprint per instance and its growth over a soak (plugin-qualify#114).

text.en: The footprint per instance and its growth over a soak.

scratchMemory.doc: The memory a plugin asks of its host for its process call.

text.en: The memory a plugin asks of its host for its process call.

latency.doc: The frames a plugin delays its output by, per rate and quantum.

text.en: The frames a plugin delays its output by, per rate and quantum.

tail.doc: How long a plugin keeps sounding once its input goes silent.

text.en: How long a plugin keeps sounding once its input goes silent.

voices.doc: The notes an instrument plays at once.

text.en: The notes an instrument plays at once.

startup.doc: The wall time of instantiate, activate and the first block.

text.en: The wall time of instantiate, activate and the first block.

threads.doc: The threads a plugin starts and their scheduling class, or the host thread pool it asks for.

text.en: The threads a plugin starts and their scheduling class, or the host thread pool it asks for.

worker.doc: The work a plugin hands to a non-real-time thread of the host.

text.en: The work a plugin hands to a non-real-time thread of the host.

blockLength.doc: The block lengths a plugin accepts.

text.en: The block lengths a plugin accepts.

openFiles.doc: The file descriptors a plugin holds after activate, and their growth.

text.en: The file descriptors a plugin holds after activate, and their growth.

diskIo.doc: The bytes a plugin reads at load and while it processes.

text.en: The bytes a plugin reads at load and while it processes.
Any socket a plugin opens.

state.doc: The size of a plugin's saved state, its save and restore time, and its round trip.

text.en: The size of a plugin's saved state, its save and restore time, and its round trip.

RESOURCE_UNITS.doc: The units a resource figure is given in; an LV2 unit's name where LV2 has one.

text.en: Nanoseconds per sample.
A count of audio frames.
Milliseconds.
Microseconds.
Seconds.
Bytes.
A plain count, with no unit.
A ratio, with no unit.

flag.doc: A yes or a no: one when the plugin does the thing, zero when it does not.

text.en: A yes or a no: one when the plugin does the thing, zero when it does not.

RESOURCE_BASES.doc: How a resource figure was known: what the plugin declares, what a run measured, or a count the caller gave the probe.

text.en: What the plugin declares about itself.
What a run measured.
A count the caller gave the probe.

RESOURCE_MEMORY_PHASES.doc: When a plugin's memory is read, per instance (plugin-qualify#114): after instantiate, after activate, at rest after processing, with notes held, and for a second instance, so a shared one-time load is told apart from the per-instance cost.

text.en: Memory read right after the plugin instantiates.
Memory read right after the plugin activates.
Memory read at rest, after processing, with no note playing.
Memory read while notes are held.
Memory read for a second instance, so a shared one-time load is told apart from the per-instance cost.

RESOURCE_UNMEASURED_REASONS.doc: Why a resource has no figure a host profile can read, beside the measurement's own reasons (MEASUREMENT_UNMEASURED_REASONS).

unmeasuredOnClass.doc: The only figure was taken on another machine class: never read as a pass, never scaled.

text.en: The only figure was taken on another machine class: never read as a pass, never scaled.

limitExceeded.doc: The run hit the limit probe isolation set for the resource; the limit is recorded beside it.

text.en: The run hit the limit probe isolation set for the resource; the limit is recorded beside it.

RESOURCE_BUDGET_SCOPES.doc: What a host profile's budget for a resource is counted over (plugin-qualify#114, #115): one plugin instance, or the whole console.

text.en: Counted over one plugin instance.
Counted over the whole console.

RESOURCE_HOST_ISOLATIONS.doc: How a host runs its plugins.

text.en: The host runs its plugins in its own process.
The host runs each plugin in its own process.
The host runs its plugins together in one process apart from its own.

RESOURCE_HOST_LATENCY_HANDLING.doc: Whether a host aligns on a plugin's reported latency or only passes it on.

text.en: The host delays every other path to align on this plugin's reported latency.
The host passes the plugin's reported latency on, without aligning other paths to it.

RESOURCE_THREAD_SCHEDULING.doc: The scheduling class a host gives its plugin's threads, as the probe output records it.

text.en: No particular scheduling class: the thread runs as any other.
The real-time FIFO scheduling class.

RESOURCE_HINTS.doc: What a plugin declares about its own footprint, in openmixer's own hints (FreeMixer/plugin-qualify#116): each a claim plugin-qualify measures and checks, carried by the extension below, as the CLAP draft and as LV2 properties. A hint a plugin does not state is unknown, never zero.

footprintAtRest.doc: The memory one instance holds at rest, once activated and idle, with no note playing.

text.en: The memory one instance holds at rest, once activated and idle, with no note playing.

footprintPerVoice.doc: The memory each voice adds while it plays, for an instrument.

text.en: The memory each voice adds while it plays, for an instrument.

sharedLoad.doc: The one-time load every instance of the plugin shares, counted once however many are instantiated.

text.en: The one-time load every instance of the plugin shares, counted once however many are instantiated.

threadsSpawned.doc: The threads the plugin starts itself, apart from any it asks the host pool for.

text.en: The threads the plugin starts itself, apart from any it asks the host pool for.

streamsFromDisk.doc: Whether the plugin reads from disk while it processes.

text.en: Whether the plugin reads from disk while it processes.

opensSockets.doc: Whether the plugin opens any socket.

text.en: Whether the plugin opens any socket.

activateTime.doc: The wall time of activate and the first block the plugin expects.

text.en: The wall time of activate and the first block the plugin expects.
